title: Ruhu Mai Tsanani a Gaɓar Kogi
intro: An ɗora wa wani matashi rai wani aiki na sirri, don ya lura daga nesa yayin da ƙaddara ke bayyana a kan ruwa. Ba a gani ko kuma ba a yi zato ba, wannan mutum zai taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen canza tarihin wata ƙasa.
clues: Mahaifiyata ta ba ni aiki, wanda ke buƙatar ɓoye sirri da taka tsantsan.
Idanuna na bin ƙaramin gadon jariri da ke shawagi a kan ruwan, zuciyata cike da damuwa.
Da wani liyafa ya same shi, sai na matso kusa, cike da tsoro.
Na ga yadda suke cikin matsananciyar damuwa game da mai kula da su kuma na bayar da mafita ba tare da na bayyana gaskiya ba.
Shiga ta cikin gaggawa ta dawo da wata rai mai shayarwa zuwa ga wanda ya fi buƙatarta.
A cikin kotunan masu iko, na yi magana: 'Shin zan nuna muku iyali da za su ciyar da shi su kuma kula da shi da kyau?'

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ta sake haɗa yaron da mahaifiyarsa
Ta ceci kanta daga hannun sojojin Fir'auna
An hukunta ta saboda leƙen asiri
outcome.answer: Ta sake haɗa yaron da mahaifiyarsa

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
